methods_quotes.q: Contact investigations were based on the six patients' locations during their contagious periods
To find the source patient, PADOH reviewed electronic records of patients evaluated in the ED on March 10 for fever and rash.
The hospital reviewed employee health records to identify any exposed personnel who did not have serologic evidence of measles immunity.
If no serology was on record, serum was drawn, and if immunoglobulin G (IgG)-negative, measles vaccine was administered
During the outbreak, the hospital reviewed serologic records of all potentially exposed employees
